newsitem.title: USA: Mattel sees higher 1997 EPS before charge.
newsitem.headline: Mattel sees higher 1997 EPS before charge.

text.p: Mattel Inc said Thursday it expects higher 1997 earnings before a one-time, pre-tax charge of about $275 million.
It said it expects earnings per share, before the charge, of $1.65 to $1.70, including a negative currency impact, versus $1.44 before one-time charges in 1996.
The company said the $275 million charge, to be taken in the first quarter, would be the combined result of its restructuring an the integration of Tyco Toys Inc.
About $175 million of the charge is related to the Tyco integration, and $100 million is related to restructuring, Mattel said.

The company said it expects first quarter earnings, before the charge, of $0.01 to $0.04 a share, down from $0.ll a year earlier. In projecting the earnings decline, it cited the Fisher-Price inventory carried over from 1996, continued weakness in Europe, and the strong dollar,
Mattel said demand for Barbie and Hot Wheels products has remained excellent, with consumer take-away for both brands rising more than 20 percent in the first quarter from a year earlier.
